entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I feel terrible about it, but I just don't have a choice.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return process for you. Could I please get your name and order number to start?
Yes, my name is Sarah Mills, and the order number is... VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet. I can definitely help with this. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it at all. The box is still unopened. I was so excited for it, but the color just wasn't what I expected when it arrived. And honestly... with some unexpected bills, I really need the money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I just hope this is okay.
I completely understand that sometimes things aren't quite what you expect, and that financial situations can change. Let me just check the policy for your order... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. I see the helmet was delivered 74 days ago. You'll be happy to know that you are well within our 90-day return window for this item.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much.

Of course. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I have just processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply attach that to the box and drop it off at a shipping center.
That's perfect. You've been incredibly helpful, Isaac.
I'm glad I could help, Sarah. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for making this so easy.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
